resources.string: Install or update Dosette on your Wear OS watch from this phone.

1. Connect the phone and watch to the same Wi-Fi network. Keep the watch charging.

2. On the watch, open Settings → System → About → Versions. Tap the build number seven times to enable developer options. Menu names may vary.

3. Open Developer options and enable ADB debugging, then Wireless debugging. Allow this Wi-Fi network.
ADB gives this phone debugging access to the watch. Dosette uses it only to check and install its own watch app. You can turn debugging off after installation. No computer or root is needed.
This installer requires Android 10 or newer on the phone.

On the watch, open Wireless debugging → Pair new device. Enter its IPv4 address, pairing port and six-digit code. Keep that window open. Pairing previously done with a computer does not pair this app.
Already paired with Dosette on this phone
Return to the main Wireless debugging screen on the watch. Enter the connection port shown there. It is usually different from the pairing port and can change when debugging restarts.
Dosette is not installed on the watch.
APK signature verified. Its signing certificate matches this phone app and the existing watch app, if installed. Certificate SHA-256:
Updates replace the app without uninstalling it or clearing its data. Older versions and different signing certificates are blocked.
This version is already installed. No update is needed.
Keep Dosette open and the watch connected. If interrupted, reconnect to check which version is installed.
The installed APK signature and version have been verified. Open Dosette on the watch to check synchronization with the phone. Then turn off ADB and wireless debugging on the watch.
Enter a valid numeric IPv4 address and a port from 1 to 65535.
Pairing failed. Reopen Pair new device on the watch and check its current code, pairing port and Wi-Fi connection.
Cannot connect. Check Wi-Fi, wireless debugging and the current connection port. If needed, return to pairing.
This device is not a compatible Wear OS watch. Nothing was installed.
The APK signature is invalid or the signing certificates do not match. Installation is blocked. Do not uninstall the existing app to bypass this check.
The watch APK could not be verified. Use a complete official Dosette build.
A newer version is installed on the watch. Update Dosette on the phone first. Downgrading is blocked to protect data.
The watch could not prepare the installation. Check available storage and reconnect.
The watch did not confirm installation. Reconnect to check the installed version. No app data was cleared.
Installation finished, but its result could not be verified. Reconnect before trying again.
The operation was interrupted. Installation may already have finished. Reconnect to check the version; no app data was cleared.
